This chapter is about taste and preference: **to like / love** (بحب — ba7ebb), **to want** (عايز — 3ayez) and **to hate** (بكره — bakrah), plus the food and drink you'll use them on. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

**حب is one verb for both *like* and *love*** (like *saber*/*conhecer* being one verb). It's a doubled verb (ح-ب-ب): **بحب (ba7ebb)**. Negate it by wrapping it in **ما...ش**: **مبحبش (maba7ebbesh)** "I don't like".

**عايز ("want") just agrees** — it's not conjugated and takes no بـ: 3ayez (m.), 3ayza (f.), 3ayzeen (pl.). Negate with **مش (mesh)**.

**بكره (bakrah) = "to hate / detest"** — a regular verb (ك-ر-ه), negated with ما...ش (مبكرهش, mabkrahsh).

**The intensity scale.** Egyptian has a clear ladder of feeling, from adoring to hating:

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| بموت في - bamoot fi | I'm crazy about / I adore |
| بحب أوي - ba7ebb awi | I love (it) a lot |
| بحب - ba7ebb | I like / love |
| مبحبش - maba7ebbesh | I don't like |
| بكره - bakrah | I hate / detest |

**بموت في** literally means "I die for" — use it for the thing you adore: *bamoot fi el-shokolata*.

And remember the demonstratives from the last chapter: **بحب ده (ba7ebb da)** "I like this", **بكره ده (bakrah da)** "I hate that".

## To like / love — حب — 7abb

Doubled verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana ha7ebb*).

| Pronoun | Present |
|---|---|
| أنا - ana | بحب - ba7ebb |
| إنت - inta | بتحب - bit7ebb |
| إنتِ - inti | بتحبي - bit7ebbi |
| هو - huwwa | بيحب - biy7ebb |
| هي - hiyya | بتحب - bit7ebb |
| إحنا - e7na | بنحب - bin7ebb |
| إنتو - intu | بتحبوا - bit7ebbu |
| هم - humma | بيحبوا - biy7ebbu |

**Negation:** *maba7ebbesh, mabit7ebbesh, mabiy7ebbesh…*

## To hate — بكره — kerih

Regular verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana hakrah*).

| Pronoun | Present |
|---|---|
| أنا - ana | بكره - bakrah |
| إنت - inta | بتكره - bitikrah |
| إنتِ - inti | بتكرهي - bitikrahi |
| هو - huwwa | بيكره - biyikrah |
| هي - hiyya | بتكره - bitikrah |
| إحنا - e7na | بنكره - binikrah |
| إنتو - intu | بتكرهوا - bitikrahu |
| هم - humma | بيكرهوا - biyikrahu |

**Negation:** *mabkrahsh…*

## To want — عايز — 3ayez

Not conjugated — it only agrees.

| Form - franco | Used by |
|---|---|
| عايز - 3ayez | a man |
| عايزة - 3ayza | a woman |
| عايزين - 3ayzeen | plural |

## Eating and drinking

The two everyday verbs that come with food. Both are regular; here are the key forms (the rest follow the usual pattern).

| Verb | I (أنا) - franco | he (هو) - franco |
|---|---|---|
| كل (eat) | باكل - bakol | بياكل - biyakol |
| شرب (drink) | بشرب - bashrab | بيشرب - biyishrab |

## Food

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| أكل - akl | food |
| عيش - 3eesh | bread |
| رز - roz | rice |
| لحمة - la7ma | meat |
| فراخ - fera5 | chicken |
| سمك - samak | fish |
| خضار - 5odar | vegetables |
| فاكهة - fakha | fruit |
| جبنة - gebna | cheese |
| شوكولاتة - shokolata | chocolate |

## Drink

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| مية - mayya | water |
| شاي - shay | tea |
| قهوة - 2ahwa | coffee |
| عصير - 3aseer | juice |
| لبن - laban | milk |

## Dialogue: "Coffee or tea?"

Tamer asks Yara about her tastes.

<span class="rotulo">تامر — Tamer</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتحبي القهوة ولا الشاي؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bit7ebbi el-2ahwa walla el-shay?</span>
<span class="en">Do you like coffee or tea?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">يارا — Yara</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بموت في القهوة!</summary>
<span class="fr">bamoot fi el-2ahwa!</span>
<span class="en">I'm crazy about coffee!</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">تامر — Tamer</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وبتاكلي لحمة؟</summary>
<span class="fr">we bitakli la7ma?</span>
<span class="en">And do you eat meat?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">يارا — Yara</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، بكره اللحمة</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, bakrah el-la7ma</span>
<span class="en">No, I hate meat</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">تامر — Tamer</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>طب بتحبي الخضار؟</summary>
<span class="fr">tab bit7ebbi el-5odar?</span>
<span class="en">OK, do you like vegetables?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">يارا — Yara</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، بحب الخضار أوي</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, ba7ebb el-5odar awi</span>
<span class="en">Yes, I like vegetables a lot</span>
</details>
